description: This file defines a Flutter widget called ResultBanner, used to display results in a Tic-Tac-Toe game UI. It shows a banner with an icon and text that can animate in and out depending on visibility, and modifies appearance based on game outcome (win or draw).

classes.name: ResultBanner
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a result message with an icon, styled according to success or error state, with animated show/hide behavior.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ResultBanner, including animated show/hide transition, icon, and styled text.
